title: Drift Wood #19 · Last Bell
logline: School lets out for the year. Not the last time. It feels like it anyway.

panels.composition: The front of Small Wood High, last day, 3:05 PM. The bell (drawn as a jagged shape). Students pouring out. WOOD, CHLOE and GULLY on the steps, not moving.

characters.pose: sitting, one step down, cap backwards

image.prompt: the front steps of a small-town high school on the last day of the year, students pouring out past three teenagers who sit on the steps not moving, a bell ringing, spruce behind

panels.composition: Wood, looking at the emptying lot.

balloons.text: One more year. Then this town will have to find someone else to underestimate.

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat sitting on school steps with his chin on his knees watching a parking lot empty

balloons.text: Tide's out at four. You coming?
I have to begin the real work.

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap standing and stretching on school steps, easy and content

panels.composition: Wide. The three of them walking away from the school toward the bay, small, in a line, Gully first. Summer. The last panel of the year.

image.prompt: three teenagers walking away from a school in a line toward a distant bay on a bright June afternoon, small in the frame, black and white, no words

notes: The last strip of the 1997–98 school year. The real work does not begin.
